variant_interface: job.variant is one fixed string from variants[family]; default is first listed. NEVER varies with fold/ordinal.

data_tasks.core300: material_labels==酸枣仁 AND roles==train, exactly300; target group_ids
data_tasks.material: fixed train/PRED roles; CAL unused; material target; material jobs only fold0

inner.seed_rule: SHA256("inner5x2|20261110|"+str(job.seed)), first8hex as uint32; same seed across family variants and folds
inner.scoring: mean macro-F1, then balanced accuracy, accuracy, smaller K, fewer PLS components, smaller gap, prefer full retain, lower C, gamma multiplier order0.1/1/10, raw before SNV

fixed_controls.spacing: fixed components2,K62; exact-cardinality dynamic programming; gaps2/4/8 or inner-selected1/2/4/8
fixed_controls.rank_context: fixed components2,K62; raw-n and SNV-n contexts distinguished; rank in [context,alpha_snv], take top62 alpha scores; final classifier onlyalpha; training-only context construction
fixed_controls.coverage: uniform endpoint-inclusive indices, contiguous-bin mean or one frozen random index set per seed/K (same across all outerfolds and their innerfits)
fixed_controls.retain_drop: choose full versus selected-alpha-only inside inner search alongside K/components/C/gamma; exact selected joint numerical gamma retained after deletion; empty alpha uses predefined training-prior DummyClassifier
fixed_controls.amplitude: raw alpha versus SNV alpha versus SNV plus per-spectrum raw mean/SD or only mean/SD
fixed_controls.permutation: fixed global permutation of core group labels before stratified nested splitting; distinct null target, never real-source metrics
fixed_controls.material: material reference context only; fixed roles, fold0 only, no PRED feedback; fixed_C10 variants use C10/gamma-scale and run only repeat0

checkpoints: rank_cache per inner/current training/PLScomponent; all candidate scores atomically after each inner fold; selection.json sealed before outer refit/prediction; resume verifies unchanged job/input/spec/code hashes
receipt: cpu_receipt.json in finally, process_time seconds for current invocation; heartbeat has current and cumulative lineage CPU; return0 success,75 CPU/signal interruption,1 error
chemistry: No measured paired chemistry supplied: no chemical-prior training family is enabled. Spacing/context are structural diagnostics, not chemical validation.
resource: One process, no subprocesses, BLAS1. RLIMIT_CPU soft limit plus bounded1-second hard grace (inherited hard limit respected). Signal checkpoints retained.
